title: STORY COLLECTION: SEE YOU SOON OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: SEE YOU SOON OPEN
DURATION: August 7, 2025, 10:00 – August 17, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: See You Soon event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain 'Broken Petals' by clearing event stages. 'Broken Petals' can be used to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments in [Unoccupied Canoe Port]. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
EVENT STAGES DURATION: August 7, 2025, 10:00 – August 14, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Unoccupied Canoe Port]
DURATION: August 7, 2025, 10:00 – August 17, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
REWARDS: Unveiling of Devotion Series - Rose Rider for Verdant, Information Fragments, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Recruitment Permits, etc.
NOTE:
- After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – AND THE CANOE'LL CARRY US TO YOU
DURATION: August 7, 2025, 10:00 – August 21, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [And the Canoe'll Carry Us to You], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Entelechia
★★★★★: Nowell / Santalla

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Entelechia
★★★★★: Nowell
Note:
- Entelechia and Nowell will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after August 21, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Entelechia and Nowell will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.

Limited-time sale at the Store

09 INTEGRATED LOOKBACK: ANOTHER TIDES OPEN
DURATION: August 7, 2025, 10:00 – August 21, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 0-11

DETAILS: After the update on August 7, 10:00 (UTC-7), new difficulty levels 16 - 18 will be available in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor (when starting a challenge at levels 16 - 18, players will initially receive the Collectible [Fosterer Genotype]). Fatty will have a chance to appear in the stages of Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor. Additionally, during the event period, players can earn 'Strategist' Points by completing Daily Missions and Limited-Time Missions. Accumulating a specified number of 'Strategist' Points will grant rewards such as Senior Operator Training Apparatus.
REWARDS: Senior Operator Training Apparatus, Chip Catalyst, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
Note:
- After the event ends, points exceeding 4500 will be converted at: 1 point = 20 LMD. The converted amount of LMD will be sent via mail.
- For detailed event information, please stay tuned to our official social media.
Please stay tuned for more information!
